nodes.name: Co2Fe oxide cluster synthesis
nodes.procedure: The solution of sodium acetate trihydrate (0.09 mol) in 70 mL was added into the vigorously agitating solution (70 mL) including Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.03 mol) and Co(NO3)2·6H2O (0.06 mol). Following 24 h of stirring at 50°C, the resulting precipitate was filtered and subjected to three washes with ethanol. Finally, the product was dried in a vacuum oven at 50°C overnight.
nodes.source_text: Preparation of preformed Co2Fe oxide cluster: ... Finally, the product was dried in a vacuum oven at 50°C overnight.

nodes.name: Ni foam pretreatment
nodes.procedure: To eliminate the surface oxides and organic molecules, the precisely cut Ni foam (2×3 cm²) underwent sequential ultrasonic cleaning with 5M HCl aqueous solution, ethanol, and deionized water for 15 min, respectively.
nodes.source_text: To eliminate the surface oxides and organic molecules, the precisely cut Ni foam (2×3 cm²) underwent sequential ultrasonic cleaning...

nodes.name: FeCo2S4@Ov-CoFe-MOF/NF solvothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Subsequently, a mixture comprising Co2Fe oxide cluster (400 mg), H2BDC-NH2 (1 mmol), and TAA (1 mmol) dissolved in 30 mL DMF, 2 mL deionized water, and 1 mL acetic acid was stirred for 30 min. The resulting solution was then transferred into the Teflon autoclave, with the pre-treated Ni foam immersed within. The autoclave was sealed for a solvothermal reaction at 150°C for 15 h. Upon natural cooling to room temperature, the as-obtained Ni foam was washed thoroughly with DMF and ethanol before being dried at 50°C under vacuum. Finally, the black Ni foam was designated as FeCo2S4@Ov-CoFe-MOF/NF.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF with nanosheets of tens of nm thickness forming porous nanoflower morphology; FeCo₂S₄/NF with coral-like nanoparticles ~40 nm diameter.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF reference exhibits nanosheets structure with smooth surfaces and the thickness of tens of nanometers ... For the pure FeCo₂S₄ / NF reference, the coral-like morphology assembled by plenty of nanoparticles with the diameter of about 40 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HR-TEM of FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF shows lattice fringes with d-spacing 0.29 nm (311) and 0.18 nm (511) for FeCo₂S₄; bright area without fringes indicates amorphous Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the target FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF, the ordered lattice fringes with the d-spacing of 0.29 and 0.18 nm ... which matches well with the (311) and (511) crystal planes of FeCo₂S₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern of FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF shows diffraction dots for (311) of FeCo₂S₄ and ambiguous halo ring confirming disordered structure of Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern of FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF ... the visible diffraction dots correspond to the (311) crystal planes of FeCo₂S₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and elemental mapping show Fe, O, C, S, and Co uniformly distributed throughout FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) and the corresponding elemental mapping results ... show that the Fe, O, C, S, and Co are uniformly distributed within the entire catalyst.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows FeCo₂S₄ peaks at 237, 289, 339 cm⁻¹; C-H stretching at 684, 807 cm⁻¹; H₂BDC-NH₂ vibrations at 1105, 1233 cm⁻¹; carboxylate stretching at 1610, 1427 cm⁻¹ confirming metal-ligand coordination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman peaks around 237, 289, and 339 cm⁻¹ are ascribed to the FeCo₂S₄. The peaks around 684 and 807 cm⁻¹ correspond to C-H stretching mode ... validating the successful coordination between metal Co/Fe ions and H₂BDC - NH₂ linkers.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS O 1s: lattice O (530.5 eV), oxygen vacancies (531.2 eV), carboxylate O (532.1 eV), surface OH/O (533.2 eV); shows Co³⁺/Co²⁺, Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ states with shifts indicating electron transfer from FeCo₂S₄ to Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution O 1s spectrum of the target FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF ... 530.5, 531.2, 532.1 and 533.2 eV ... The above shift of S 2p, Co 2p, and Fe 2p suggests the electron transfer from FeCo₂S₄ to Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF.

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR shows pronounced peaks at g=2.003 for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF indicating abundant oxygen vacancies vs weak signal for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe-MOF/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As depicted in Fig. 3b, a weak symmetrical EPR signal is observed for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe - MOF / NF, while a pair of pronounced peaks are captured for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF at the same g = 2.003.

nodes.characterization_summary: PALS shows higher τ₁=144.7 ps for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF indicating atomic-level oxygen vacancies; I₁ increases 8.0%, I₂ decreases 8.2%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As observed, the FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF exhibits a higher τ₁ value of approximately 144.7 ps ... the relative intensities I₁ and I₂ for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF exhibit an increase of 8.0% and a decrease of 8.2%.

nodes.characterization_summary: KPFM surface potential difference at heterointerface: >30 mV for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF (enhanced BEF) vs 19 mV for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe-MOF/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the surface potential difference at the heterointerface is about 19 mV for the FeCo₂S₄@CoFe - MOF / NF reference. After introducing the oxygen vacancies, the surface potential difference has reached up to over 30 mV for the target FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF.

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS shows Co L₃-edge ~781.8 eV, Fe L₃-edge ~711.1 eV for FeCo₂S₄; pronounced shift to higher energy and decreased intensity across interface in FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 3g-k, the peaks around 781.8 and 711.1 eV are ascribed to the Co L₃-edge and Fe L₃-edge of FeCo₂S₄ ... for the FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ CoFe-MOF/NF, the L₃-edge peaks of Fe and Co exhibit a pronounced shift towards higher energy.

nodes.characterization_summary: Water contact angle 19.47° for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe-MOF/NF, lower for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF; underwater contact angle 150.41° indicating superaerophilicity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As displayed in Fig. S11, the water contact angle of FeCo₂S₄@CoFe - MOF / NF is determined to be 19.47°, much lower than that of FeCo₂S₄ / NF (33.74°) ... FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe-MOF/NF also exhibits the superaerophilicity with the underwater contact angle of 150.41°.

nodes.characterization_summary: UPS valence band maximum: 8.32 eV for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ-CoFe-MOF/NF (closer to E_F) vs 9.34 eV for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe-MOF/NF; work function φ=6.27 eV vs 6.36 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the valence band maximum (VBM) value of FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF is calculated to be 8.32 eV, which is lower than that of FeCo₂S₄@CoFe - MOF / NF (9.34 eV) ... the φ value is determined to be 6.27 eV for FeCo₂S₄@Oᵥ - CoFe - MOF / NF and 6.36 eV for FeCo₂S₄@CoFe - MOF / NF.
